section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single cross-sectional study that explored the relationship between body appreciation and sexual function in 247 women aged 18 to 58. The study found that body appreciation was modestly negatively correlated with BMI, and after controlling for other factors, body appreciation predicted aspects of sexual function. The study suggests that encouraging body appreciation may improve sexual function.
